name: Chroma
desc: Open-source search infrastructure: vector, full-text, regex, metadata
desc_zh: 开源检索基础设施，兼容向量、全文、正则与元数据
solves: Semantic search that needs a running database service eats an afternoon. Retrieval runs serverless on object storage, or embedded in the app.
solves_zh: 语义检索要先跑起一个数据库服务，搭完要一下午。检索可以无服务器跑在对象存储上，也能嵌进应用。
best_for: When a prototype needs real retrieval and you refuse to run a database server.
best_for_zh: 当原型需要真正的检索，而你又不想再跑一个数据库服务时。
notes: Lets a prototype run real retrieval without standing up any database server. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://aiwiki.ai/wiki/vector_database 2026-11-25：released 2022-10-01/day → 2022-10-22/day; source https://api.github.com/repos/chroma-core/chroma/releases。原值 2022-10-01 是月份占位。官方仓库创建于 2022-10-05，最早的发布版本是 0.0.2（2022-10-22）
